name: source-repo
body: Source lives in the public GitHub repo `github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide` (https://github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide; git@github.com:really-knows-ai/kalide.git). The Go module path is `github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide`; the CLI binary is `kalide`, built from `cmd/kalide`, and kalide's environment variables use the `KALIDE_` prefix (e.g. `KALIDE_BINARY`). AC: `go.mod` declares exactly that module path and all internal imports use it.
